notes: Scripts run in the XScript app (Chaquopy Python 3.10, numpy, opencv, pillow, requests, pyyaml).
Two API families: xscript.android.* (native) and ascript.android.* (drop-in for AScript scripts; `from ascript.android import ...` works unchanged).
Coordinates are screen pixels in the current orientation.
Channel: accessibility or root, chosen by the run mode (auto / accessibility / root).
Device /eval runs in a separate :eval process that is killed on timeout; assign the answer to `_result`.

modules.name: xscript.android.action
modules.description: Gestures, touch, keys and text input through the current channel (accessibility or root).

functions.name: click
functions.doc: Tap (x, y). x may also be a Point/tuple/node.

functions.name: swipe
functions.signature: swipe(x1, y1, x2, y2, dur=300) -> bool

functions.name: gesture
functions.doc: Multi-finger gesture: [{'points': [(x, y), ...], 'start': ms, 'duration': ms}, ...]; strokes run in parallel.

functions.name: input
functions.doc: Set text on the focused / first editable node.

modules.name: xscript.android.node
modules.description: Accessibility node selector (text/id/desc/type/state filters, relations) and XPath 1.0 queries.

classes.name: Selector
classes.doc: Chain filters then find(). String filters are exact unless regex() or *_contains is used. xpath: //TextView[@text='设置'], contains()/starts-with()/matches(), and/or/not(), [1]/[last()], (//Button)[1], ancestor::/following-sibling::, //A | //B, //LinearLayout[.//Switch]. Attributes: text, resource-id, content-desc, class, package, hint, bounds, index, clickable, checked, ...
methods: clickable() long_clickable() editable() enabled() visible() checkable() checked() focusable() focused() scrollable() selected()

classes.name: Node
classes.doc: Fields: path, id, text, desc, type, rect, clickable, editable, enabled; left/top/right/bottom/width/height/center_x/center_y.

modules.name: xscript.android.screen
modules.description: Screenshots, colour search, template (image) search and OCR. Rects are [l, t, r, b].

functions.name: capture
functions.doc: Save a PNG on the device and return its path.

functions.name: cache
functions.doc: Freeze one frame for the following searches.

functions.name: size
functions.doc: Screen size in the current orientation.

functions.name: find_colors
functions.signature: find_colors(colors, rect=None, sim=0.9, space=5, ori=2, image=None) -> Point | None
functions.doc: First point matching a colour pattern (first colour absolute, rest relative offsets).

functions.name: find_all_colors
functions.signature: find_all_colors(colors, rect=None, sim=0.9, space=5, ori=2, max_num=0, image=None) -> list[Point]

functions.name: find_image
functions.signature: find_image(template, rect=None, confidence=0.9, rgb=False, scale_range=None, image=None) -> dict | None
functions.doc: Template match. Template may be a path, ndarray or list. Returns {result:(cx,cy), rect:[l,t,r,b], center_x, center_y, confidence, index}. Transparent PNG pixels are masked.

functions.name: find_all_images
functions.signature: find_all_images(template, rect=None, confidence=0.9, rgb=False, maxcnt=0, scale_range=None, image=None) -> list[dict]

functions.name: ocr
functions.doc: ML Kit Chinese+Latin OCR. OcrResult has text, confidence, rect, center_x, center_y and dict-style access.

functions.name: ocr_click
functions.doc: Find text and tap its centre.

modules.name: xscript.android.system
modules.description: Apps, device info, shell (root), clipboard, key-value store, resources (R), toast/vibrate/tts, run options and 定时任务.

functions.name: open
functions.doc: Launch an app by label or package.

functions.name: wait_for_package
functions.doc: Wait until the package is in front.

functions.name: shell
functions.doc: ShellResult: code, out, err, ok (AScript aliases res, error). timeout in seconds.

functions.name: reboot
functions.doc: End this run and start the project again in a fresh script process after delay seconds.

classes.name: Config
classes.doc: Run options of a project (default: the running one), same as the switches on the project screen.
methods: set_auto_run(on=True, project=None)  # 开机自启, one boot project per device
set_stop_re_run(on=True, project=None)  # 停止后重新运行, not after a user stop

classes.name: Schedule
classes.doc: 定时任务 (device-local time). One script runs at a time; if_running='skip' | 'restart'.
methods: daily(time, weekdays=None, project=None, if_running='skip', wake=True)  # '08:30', weekdays 1=Mon..7=Sun
every(minutes, window='', project=None, if_running='skip', wake=True)  # window '08:00-23:00'
once(at, project=None, ...)  # epoch seconds, datetime or 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'

modules.name: xscript.android.ui
modules.description: Overlays: toast, dialogs, HTML web windows with a JS bridge, drawing canvas, image window, floating stop button.

functions.name: show_image
functions.doc: Preview an image in an overlay.

classes.name: Window
classes.doc: HTML overlay. JS calls window.xscript.call(key, value) (alias window.airscript.call) and window.xscript.close().

modules.name: xscript.android.event
modules.description: Event listeners: physical keys, view click/long_click/scroll, notifications, toasts, raw accessibility events. Handlers run one at a time on a daemon thread; keep the script alive with a loop or event.loop(). Keys/touch/toast/a11y need 无障碍; notifications use 通知使用权 when granted (else accessibility, less data).

functions.name: on
functions.doc: event_type: key | touch | notification | toast | a11y. Filters match fields (value, list of values, or callable). Decorator without fn.

functions.name: off
functions.doc: Remove one handler, a type, or everything.

functions.name: wait
functions.doc: Block for the next matching event.

functions.name: on_key
functions.doc: e.key_code (24 vol+, 25 vol-, 4 back), e.action 'down'/'up'. Observed, never consumed.

functions.name: on_touch
functions.doc: e.action click/long_click/scroll, e.x, e.y (view center), e.package, e.text.

functions.name: on_notification
functions.doc: e.package, e.title, e.text, e.time; e.send() opens it.

functions.name: status
functions.doc: Subscribed types and whether 通知使用权 is connected.

classes.name: Event
classes.doc: Fields as attributes and keys; e.type is the kind.

modules.name: ascript.android
modules.description: AScript compatibility package (modelled on ascript-tip 1.3.0). Existing AScript projects run unchanged; import with `from ascript.android import action, node, screen, system, ui, media`.

functions.name: action.click / swipe / slide / input
functions.signature: click(x, y=None, dur=20); slide(x, y, x1, y1, dur=20)

functions.name: action.Touch / Key / Path / gesture / Ime / catch_click
node.Selector
functions.doc: AScript method names (hintText, packageName, childCount, longClickable, ...).

functions.name: screen.capture / capture_cv / capture_pil / cache / get_color
functions.doc: Screenshots and bitmap helpers (bitmap_to_file, bitmap_crop, bitmap_base64, ...).

functions.name: screen.FindImages
functions.doc: Masked multi-scale template matching (ascv-derived). find/find_all with method='smart' and find_sift fall back to template matching.

functions.name: screen.Ocr
functions.signature: Ocr.mlkitocr_v2(rect=None, pattern=None, confidence=0.5) / paddleocr(...) / find / wait / click
functions.doc: All engines map to ML Kit; results are dict-like OcrResult objects.

functions.name: system.*
functions.doc: Device, Clipboard, KeyValue, R, Config, shell, open, browser, get_foreground_app, ...

functions.name: ui.*
functions.doc: WebWindow, Dialog, Loger, FloatWindow, ImageWindow, Canvas.

functions.name: event.KeyEvent / TouchEvent / NotificationEvent
functions.doc: Same fields as AScript; NotificationEvent event.send() opens the notification, event.raw is None.

functions.name: node.Selector.on_event / system.Notification.listen
functions.doc: Accessibility events (getEventType/getPackageName/getText) and notifications; pass None to stop.

functions.name: system.Config / reboot
functions.doc: 开机自启, 停止后重新运行, and re-running the project in a fresh process.

unsupported: screen.gp files from AScript's 图色工具

modules.name: devtools
modules.description: Device-hosted developer tools at http://<device>:<port>/tools/ (图色工具, 标注工具, 投屏) and the matching MCP tools. Not importable from scripts.

functions.name: take_snapshot
functions.doc: Freeze the screen; all checks below run on this frame.

functions.name: vision_test
functions.signature: vision_test(snapshot_id, op, colors='', rect=None, sim=0.9, x=0, y=0, template='', template_rect=None, confidence=0.8)
functions.doc: op = pixel | find_colors | compare_colors | find_image | ocr. Same engine as xscript.android.screen and ascript FindColors / CompareColors / FindImages / Ocr. Tune colors, sim and rects here before writing code.

functions.name: crop_template
functions.doc: Save a snapshot region as a PNG template in a project, for FindImages / screen.find_image.

functions.name: list_datasets / export_dataset
functions.doc: 标注 datasets; export writes a YOLO zip (images/{train,val}, labels/{train,val}, data.yaml).

functions.name: screen stream
functions.doc: MJPEG 投屏 for browsers (max 2 viewers). Each part carries X-Screen-Size with the full resolution.
